revision_method: npx tsx scripts/implementation-revision.ts; hash of sorted implementation/test/migration/script/dependency/config paths and bytes, excluding private configuration and documentation

dependency_audit.note: No dependency changes after this audit; reports reflect advisory data available at execution.

local_smoke.observed: Built app opens in Codex in-app browser and shows honest missing-cloud-configuration readiness state. No participant data or microphone was used.

limitations: Synthetic provider/browser events are not actual audio, network or intended-device observations.
Embedded PostgreSQL validates SQL/data behavior but does not prove deployed Supabase roles, network routing or cloud multi-session contention.
Backup covers the nine care tables; provider Auth users/settings, secrets and local session revocations require separate recovery.
UI/voice pending state is in memory; persistent offline recovery is S03.
No real care/household data, transcripts, provider credentials or private evidence is included.
